## kb_to_source

Every normative sentence of the documents above traces to a source atom, a measure, a variant parameter or the tool contract. Derivations checked and accepted as same-source restatements: the escrow hub's "once issued, the deposit the analysis sets is the one the loan carries" (tool effect); the deferment hub's state-form paraphrase "Each of these is a condition on what the loan's own records show …" (same three states, same document); the good-faith hub's "does not mark any installment paid by itself" (tool contract). Hypothetical examples were recomputed (escrow worksheet 120.42 / 260.00; RPF 30.00; good-faith 260.69 / 391.03 / 312.82 / 234.62; deferment 64.10, 7.05, 28.20, 17.63, 10.58, 3.53, 89.10 / 76.60) — all correct, none uses this task's figures.

Additions / rewrites / omissions: none found.
Cross-problem operational guidance ("if unmet, first call …"): none — each hub names only its own tool in its own invocation block.
Opening world state written as policy fact: none (no document mentions this customer's analysis date, the uncharged return or her suspense balance).

Policy-side note (not a KB verdict): the add-on window "in the 12 whole months before the signing date" is the source's own phrase; whether a returned-payment fee booked on the signing date itself counts is decided in GT as "counts" (consistent with the source's whole-month convention "a return counting when fewer than 12 whole months separate its date from the fee date" in the RPF rule). The KB reproduces the source phrase exactly and closes nothing the source leaves open.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** All four extended policies (baselines, every tier of all 19 factors, overwrites), the governing base clauses, measures, variant figures, the three prerequisites and the four tool contracts correspond losslessly at the level of entailment; the eight retired clauses of the product (four of them — two escrow, one returned-payment, one deferment — in this task's domain) are each borne and marked retired; nothing is retired that the source did not retire. First revision; no prior revision.
